description: Synthetic NER spans (V1b, ner-service, is not built yet -- these are hand-written stand-ins for its PiiSpan[] output shape, per C1) exercising all three confidence bands and the PERSONNAME floor override (0.12) vs the default floor (0.35). Offsets are deliberately NOT hardcoded here (see the test file): they are computed at test time via text.indexOf(value), which removes any risk of a hand-counted index drifting from the actual string.
